title: L2 Gate: enforce the tier floor as a required, deterministic merge gate
acceptance: quorum-verify wired as a required status check on protect-main; branch-protection approvals flipped 0->1; quorum-gate App-as-identity established (Owner-only setup, longest lead)

PREREQUISITE - authenticated base-policy read: the Gate's forge-mode path reads .quorum/policy.json from the authenticated PR base event (merge-base), never the PR head (forge-mode counterpart of QRM-3.2's local fix)

PREREQUISITE - mechanical branch-freshness: 'require branches up to date before merge' is enforced or consumed as an unspoofable forge signal, closing the stale-tightening residual from QRM-3.2's merge-base grading decision

PREREQUISITE - trusted verifier code: the Gate runs a pinned/base verifier version, NOT arbitrary PR-head code; a PR cannot alter the verifier that grades it (QRM-3.2 secures policy DATA, not verifier CODE)
PREREQUISITE - mode-bearing diff (QRM-3.1): the Gate consumes a mode-carrying diff (local git diff --raw, or an equivalent GitHubForge.compare) so symlink/gitlink floors hold in the enforcement path
PREREQUISITE - GitHubForge parity: GitHubForge.compare returns mode-bearing, rename-faithful DiffEntry[] (currently fails closed by throwing) before any forge-mode tier/coverage decision

the Gate is not claimed as complete tier-floor enforcement until every acceptance item prefixed 'PREREQUISITE' in this manifest is met, regardless of their order in the list (principle 2: do not claim enforcement not shipped)

PREREQUISITE - delegated/transitive agent-config references (opencode + CLAUDE.md): a floored config that references arbitrary files via opencode.json/.jsonc instructions:/{file:} or CLAUDE.md @import must not let a PR edit the referenced file at a tier below the config's floor; closed by QRM-3.4 (dynamic floor of parsed reference targets). A floor delegation can bypass = a leaky Gate.

PREREQUISITE - Cursor delegated references (residual from QRM-3.4): QRM-3.4 defers transitive references from a .cursor .mdc rule to a non-.cursor file (direct .cursor/** is floored; only the .mdc->target delegation is open). This residual is NOT closed by QRM-3.4 and is its own Gate prerequisite; it requires first-party sourcing of the Cursor reference grammar before implementation (per the QRM-3.4 lesson that a reference grammar must not be implemented from memory).

PREREQUISITE - OpenCode non-instructions delegated surfaces (residual from QRM-3.4): QRM-3.4 covers only auto-loaded `instructions` and instruction-field `{file:}` content. First-party OpenCode also exposes (a) the `references` object (opencode.ai/docs/references) making local dirs / git repos available to the agent by alias, and (b) manual `@refs` inside AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md-as-AGENTS that opencode does NOT auto-parse but instructs the agent to Read on demand. These are agent-steering AVAILABILITY surfaces, not deterministic content loading, so they are out of QRM-3.4; they are recorded here so the Gate does not imply OpenCode delegated trust is complete. Classify as Gate-blocking vs tracked-only when sourced.

PREREQUISITE - authenticated-forge tree listing (surfaced by QRM-3.4): the forge adapter exposes listFiles at the trusted ref (the forge-mode counterpart of `git ls-tree -r`), so the resolver can enumerate reference-bearing configs (e.g. all **/CLAUDE.md) and resolve delegated references in forge mode. Without it, forge-mode reference resolution is incomplete and delegated floors do not hold at the Gate.
